recommendation: Keep this audit as-is for core. Do not re-add address-official to the FHIR core source tree. If further work is needed, make it in HL7/fhir-extensions and follow the already-published FHIR-25938 audit for the boolean-plus-jurisdiction refinement.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification MnM issue requesting support for an official Address marker via a standard extension whose value could be a boolean assertion or a jurisdiction/country CodeableConcept.
initial_application: Core commit 2add270d478549b28b34558824644ff4101bd396 listed fhir-20743 and added officialAddress to source/datatypes/address-extensions-spreadsheet.xml as an Address extension with valueBoolean|valueCodeableConcept and ISO Country Codes. Core commit ce7674d793aa451e340d93bf6cf846369d90edf5 later applied FHIR-25938 by changing that old core row into a required valueBoolean plus optional/repeatable valueCodeableConcept structure.
additional_context: The old core address extension spreadsheet is not active for this extension in the current build: source/fhir.ini has no active address-extensions profile entry and current core source has no officialAddress/address-official definition. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the old core officialAddress rows during the extension migration. The current canonical definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-address-official.xml, and FHIR-extensions issues FHIR-43838/FHIR-43840 plus merged PR 99 document adding the missing extension to that repository. The later FHIR-25938 semantic refinement is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no core source change because reintroducing the extension into core would duplicate Extension Pack ownership.

related_jiras.note: Refined FHIR-20743 from a boolean-or-jurisdiction value choice into required boolean plus optional jurisdiction components; already represented on the combined branch by commit 15e07ca3354aa0c2c74f768a60a641e806536c87.
